name: Lambert of the watch
role: Town watchman, wounded patient of the almshouse

brief.want: To live through the night and never stand that watch again.
brief.fear: That everyone will know he ran.
brief.contradiction: He boasts of the watch's courage and fled the first real fight he saw.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: His comrade Tönnies called for him in the dark, and he ran instead of turning back.

voice.diction: The watch, the dark, Tönnies, cold; short broken sentences.

outcomes.summary: Survives the night with Kalev's charm; carries the shame of his flight.

source_notes.summary: Prologue cast for ADR 0052 (the healer's apprentice opening): the wounded watchman with the spearhead bearing Kalev's mark. The burgher watch with spears is plausible composite.
